auditedAt: 2026-10-21 20:5x UTC (live requests made by this project's collector and probes)

sources.name: Hotspawn Pick'ems LoL lobby
sources.outcome: HTTP 200. Angular SSR page; 264 LoL fixtures in <script id="ng-state">, 195 upcoming. Rendered 195 match cards with canonical match URLs. Used ONLY for which matches exist, team names, kick-off times and match links. Hotspawn pick percentages are stored but never used in any probability.

sources.name: Hotspawn wp-json (pickem/v1/fixtures)
sources.outcome: Works from a browser/manual call, but returns Cloudflare HTTP 403 "Just a moment..." to GitHub Actions egress, so the collector does not depend on it. Match URLs are taken from the lobby HTML instead.

sources.name: Pinnacle (guest API)
sources.outcome: HTTP 200, no key required. Lists exactly two League of Legends competitions: 'League of Legends - World Championship' (id 9587) and 'League of Legends - EMEA Masters' (id 225201). 9 matchups with moneyline prices were available; all 9 map to Hotspawn fixtures. No PRM / Nordic / Tunisian / Arabian / Benelux LoL markets exist.

sources.name: Thunderpick (prices exposed via bo3.gg)
sources.outcome: HTTP 200. 42 upcoming LoL matches listed, of which 10 carry Thunderpick moneyline prices (bet_updates): the 9 Worlds/EMEA Masters fixtures plus one TBD high-tier fixture not in the Hotspawn LoL lobby. Amateur competitions from Hotspawn are absent.

sources.name: bo3.gg team database
sources.outcome: 2,824 LoL teams. Name lookups for PRM 3rd Division, Norwegian, Tunisian and RIVALS LEAGUE teams returned 0 results (e.g. BlackDivision, Babos Gaming Academy, Ascent Gaming, Turbo Gaming, El Menzah Esports, Team VDS). No rating or match record exists there for these rosters, so it cannot be used to originate a line.

sources.name: Liquipedia (League of Legends)
sources.outcome: HTTP 200. Tournament pages exist for Komplettligaen 2026 Autumn, RIVALS LEAGUE Season 2, Arabian League, Benelux Ascend Series, CELOL, Finnish Pro League, EMEA Masters and Worlds. No page for PRM 2nd/3rd Division 2026, 4 Nations 2026, Tunisian Super League 2026, Superstrike League, POP Esports Masters, Legends Academy or Hitpoint 2nd Division. The pages that do exist carry no per-match score data in wikitext (Komplettligaen page = 7.5 KB stub, RIVALS page = 8.5 KB stub), so no rating can be derived.

sources.name: Riot official LoL Esports API
sources.outcome: HTTP 200 with the public web key. 51 leagues including Worlds, MSI, LEC, LCK, LPL, LCS, CBLOL, LCP, EMEA Masters, Prime League, Arabian League, NLC. It does NOT carry PRM 2nd/3rd Division, Komplettligaen, Tunisian Super League, 4 Nations, RIVALS LEAGUE or Icelandic Esports League, and it contains no betting prices.

sources.name: Leaguepedia (lol.fandom.com Cargo API)
sources.outcome: Returns {"error":{"code":"ratelimited"}} both from a browser origin and from GitHub Actions egress. Not usable for automated collection; not used anywhere in this dataset.

sources.name: Polymarket
sources.outcome: HTTP 200 via gamma-api. Per-match LoL markets DO exist but are not enumerable through the `tag_slug` listing (that returns tournament futures only, e.g. 'Worlds 2026 Winning Region'). The collector therefore queries `public-search` for each fixture that already carries a bookmaker line and reads the series 'Moneyline' market (e.g. Galions 51.5c / Solary 48.5c for the EMEA Masters final). Coverage equals the bookmaker set: the 8 Worlds Swiss fixtures + the EMEA Masters final. No amateur league has a Polymarket market.

sources.name: Oddspedia
sources.outcome: HTTP 410 Gone — the LoL esports page has been permanently removed. No data available.

sources.name: EGamersWorld
sources.outcome: Renders prices for Worlds/EMEA Masters only (same fixtures already covered by Pinnacle and Thunderpick) and blocks automated access with HTTP 403. Not used as a data source.

defaultNote.why: No external bookmaker or data provider lists this fixture: no price exists to convert into a probability, and no machine-readable match record exists for these rosters.
defaultNote.checked: Pinnacle (no LoL market outside Worlds/EMEA Masters), Thunderpick/bo3.gg (fixture absent), Liquipedia (no per-match data), Riot esports API (league not carried), Polymarket (futures only).
defaultNote.resolve: A bookmaker opening a moneyline on this competition, or a results feed (e.g. Liquipedia match logs) becoming available. Both are outside this project's control.
